Infrabel Procurement sends the supplier an invitation in this regard about 6 months before the qualification's expiry date. The supplier shall submit the new administrative and/or technical file within 2 months. If the supplier does not take timely action, it runs the risk that its qualification extension is not completed before expiry date. Infrabel reserves the right to perform a quality audit, if this is deemed necessary, before extending the qualification. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions.
